MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub reports [options] [command]

Run extensible sync/storage reports from local state

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]       List the available reports
  show [options] <id>  Run a single report and print its results
  help [command]       display help for command

Examples:
  $ memoriahub reports list
  $ memoriahub reports show overview
  $ memoriahub reports show storage --json
  $ memoriahub reports show duplicates
